szoveg_eredeti: It has been reported that older Americans lost $2.4 billion to scams in 2024. However, the Federal Trade Commission says the real number, due under reporting, is much greater. More than half of victims never report falling victim to scams due to feelings of embarrassment. Join us as Donald Bach presents information about what Artificial Intelligence (AI) is, how AI is being used today by scammers, how to identify these savvy scams, and most importantly, learn what we need to know to help prevent us from falling victim.

prioritas.lead_hu: A madisoni önkormányzat tájékoztató előadást szervez az idős korosztályt célzó, mesterséges intelligenciával elkövetett csalások felismeréséről.
